### What it does

The function walks through the input string, groups consecutive identical characters into runs, and writes each run-length group as `char<count>` to `dest`:

| Step | Input character(s) | Written to `dest` |
|------|-------------------|--------------------|
| 1    | `'a' × 2`         | `"a2"`             |
| 2    | `'b' × 1`         | `"b1"`             |
| 3    | `'c' × 5`         | `"c5"`             |
| …    | …                 | …                  |

The `count` is converted to decimal digits, supporting single-, double-, and triple-digit counts (≥ 100).
